description: Header file defining utility functions for JSON parsing, configuration search, and testing within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, intended for unit tests related to 'cvd' commands.

methods.name: ParseJsonString
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Json::Value object.

methods.name: FindConfig
methods.description: Searches for a specific element within a vector of strings.

methods.name: FindConfigIgnoreSpaces
methods.description: Searches for a string within a vector, ignoring spaces.

methods.name: LaunchCvdParserTester
methods.description: Runs a test that involves parsing JSON and configuring elements, returning a Result with a vector of strings.
